entities.name: Dominic Đặng Văn Cầu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dominic Đặng Văn Cầu is a Vietnamese prelate. He was appointed Bishop of Thái Bình on 29 October 2022. Cầu was set to be appointed bishop with Joseph Bùi Công Trác on the same day, but Trác was appointed later on 1 November due to Archbishop Joseph Nguyễn Năng being on a retreat. He was ordained to the priesthood in 1996 and previously served as Rector of the Sacred Heart Major Seminary of Thái Bình since 2017. He was ordained bishop on 31 December 2022 in front of the Diocesan Pastoral Center and consecrated by Archbishop Joseph Nguyễn Năng.
